name: Miracle Tower
tagline: Luxury high rise in the heart of Pattaya

directSale.funnelCopy: Completed in 2025, Miracle Tower rises 29 storeys over central Pattaya's 3rd Road, putting the city's beaches, dining and nightlife a short walk away. Its 476 residences range from smart studios to 1-bedroom homes, above ground-floor shop units, with a full resort amenity deck. A finished, move-in-ready address in the heart of the city.
